schema.text: When you use public transport, do pleasant or unpleasant surroundings affect how you feel?
schema.help: For example buildings, squares, how cared-for a place is and its general feel. Think about waiting at stops and travelling on board public transport.

options.text: No, I don't pay attention to them
I notice them, but they rarely make a difference
They affect a lot how I feel on the way
I sometimes choose a route because it's nicer or more interesting

en.#When you use public transport, do pleas: When you use public transport, do pleasant or unpleasant surroundings affect how you feel?
en.#No, I don't pay attention to them: No, I don't pay attention to them
en.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: I notice them, but they rarely make a difference
en.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: They affect a lot how I feel on the way
en.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: I sometimes choose a route because it's nicer or more interesting
en.#For example buildings, squares, how car: For example buildings, squares, how cared-for a place is and its general feel. Think about waiting at stops and travelling on board public transport.

it.#When you use public transport, do pleas: Quando usi i mezzi pubblici, l’ambiente intorno, piacevole o sgradevole, influisce su come ti senti?
it.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Ci faccio caso, ma raramente fanno differenza
it.#Sometimes they affect my mood: A volte influiscono sul mio umore
it.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Influiscono molto su come mi sento lungo la strada
it.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: A volte scelgo un percorso perché è più bello o più interessante
it.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Per esempio edifici, piazze, quanto un luogo è curato e la sua atmosfera in generale. Pensa all’attesa alla fermata e al viaggio a bordo dei mezzi pubblici.

fr.#When you use public transport, do pleas: Lorsque vous utilisez les transports en commun, un cadre agréable ou désagréable influence-t-il ce que vous ressentez ?
fr.#No, I don't pay attention to them: Non, je n'y fais pas attention
fr.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Je les remarque, mais elles font rarement une différence
fr.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Elles influencent beaucoup ce que je ressens en chemin
fr.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Je choisis parfois un itinéraire parce qu'il est plus agréable ou plus intéressant
fr.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Par exemple les bâtiments, les places, l'entretien d'un lieu et son atmosphère générale. Pensez à l’attente aux arrêts et au trajet à bord des transports en commun.

de.#When you use public transport, do pleas: Beeinflusst eine angenehme oder unangenehme Umgebung bei Fahrten mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, wie Sie sich fühlen?
de.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Ich merke es, aber es macht selten einen Unterschied
de.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Sie beeinflussen stark, wie ich mich unterwegs fühle
de.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Manchmal wähle ich eine Strecke, weil sie schöner oder interessanter ist
de.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Zum Beispiel Gebäude, Plätze, wie gepflegt ein Ort ist und wie er insgesamt wirkt. Denken Sie an das Warten an Haltestellen und die Fahrt in öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln.

tr.#When you use public transport, do pleas: Toplu taşıma kullanırken hoş veya hoş olmayan çevre kendinizi nasıl hissettiğinizi etkiliyor mu?
tr.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Fark ederim ama nadiren bir fark yaratırlar
tr.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Bazen daha güzel veya ilginç olduğu için bir güzergâh seçerim
tr.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Örneğin binalar, meydanlar, bir yerin ne kadar bakımlı olduğu ve genel havası. Duraklarda beklemeyi ve toplu taşıma araçlarında yolculuk yapmayı düşünün.

fa.#When you use public transport, do pleas: هنگام استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی، آیا محیط خوشایند یا ناخوشایند بر حال شما اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: متوجه آن‌ها می‌شوم، اما به‌ندرت فرقی ایجاد می‌کنند
fa.#Sometimes they affect my mood: گاهی بر حال من اثر می‌گذارند
fa.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: خیلی بر حس من در مسیر اثر می‌گذارند
fa.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: گاهی مسیری را انتخاب می‌کنم چون زیباتر یا جالب‌تر است
fa.#For example buildings, squares, how car: مثلاً ساختمان‌ها، میدان‌ها، میزان رسیدگی به یک محل و حال‌وهوای کلی آن. انتظار در ایستگاه‌ها و سفر با وسایل حمل‌ونقل عمومی را در نظر بگیرید.

hu.#When you use public transport, do pleas: Tömegközlekedés közben befolyásolja a közérzetét, ha kellemes vagy kellemetlen a környezet?
hu.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Nagyon befolyásolják, hogyan érzem magam az úton
hu.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Néha azért választok útvonalat, mert szebb vagy érdekesebb
hu.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Például az épületek, terek, egy hely gondozottsága és általános hangulata. Gondoljon a megállókban való várakozásra és a tömegközlekedési járműveken való utazásra.

ar.#When you use public transport, do pleas: عند استخدام وسائل النقل العام، هل تؤثر البيئة المحيطة، الجميلة أو غير الجميلة، في شعورك؟
ar.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: ألاحظها، لكنها نادرًا ما تُحدث فرقًا
ar.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: تؤثر كثيرًا في شعوري أثناء الطريق
ar.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: أختار أحيانًا طريقًا لأنه أجمل أو أكثر إثارة للاهتمام
ar.#For example buildings, squares, how car: مثل المباني والساحات ومدى العناية بالمكان وجوّه العام. فكّر في الانتظار في المحطات والسفر على متن وسائل النقل العام.
